name: Bookmarks
location: Firefox: places.sqlite, bookmarkbackups\bookmarks-<date>.jsonlz4 ; Chrome/Edge: Bookmarks (JSON), Bookmarks.bak (Chrome) / Bookmarks.msbak (Edge)
purpose: Records default browser items as well as sites a user chose to save for future reference.
normal_baseline: Bookmark set matches the user's known interests/workflow, added at a reasonable, spaced-out cadence.
anomalies: A bookmark for a known malicious, C2, or paste-site URL that does not otherwise appear in browsing history, indicating a reference was saved without (yet) being visited
A burst of bookmarks added in a short window inconsistent with normal usage, suggesting bulk import or scripted activity
A Bookmarks.bak/backup copy showing entries later deleted from the live Bookmarks file
anti_forensic_notes: Firefox retains multiple dated backups in bookmarkbackups\, and Chrome/Edge keep a .bak/.msbak copy of the prior save, so deleting a single live bookmark file does not remove these backup copies. Recently-deleted bookmarks are frequently recoverable.
interpretation: Firefox's bookmarkbackups folder can hold multiple backup copies of the entire bookmark set in JSON format inside a compressed jsonlz4 container, letting an analyst diff bookmark state across dates. Chromium Bookmark files are plain JSON. Not all bookmarks are user-generated intent to visit. A URL can be bookmarked and never actually visited, so a bookmark alone is not proof of a visit.
